Part of the Learning in Harmony Trust
"In the Learning in Harmony Trust, we work in harmony to achieve excellence for all. We live and breathe our values and focus on doing things the right way, providing the perfect environment for all our children to flourish and succeed. And with a diverse range of schools in two contrasting locations, we offer a unique opportunity for professionals looking for a challenging and rewarding career in a supportive, creative and forward-thinking environment." Click here to find out more about the LiH Trust.
Learning today for tomorrow's world
Welcome to Drew
Drew Primary School is a nurturing and inclusive school in Silvertown, East London. We are proud to be a part of the Learning in Harmony Trust: a team of schools spread across London and Southend.
We believe in celebrating success for every child, at every level. With high expectations and ambition for all, we are driven by a belief that 'better is possible'.

Parents
In this section, we aim to provide you with the key information you will need to know while your child is at Drew Primary School.
drew families handbook 2026 27.pdf
Below are quick links to key forms or resources you may need:
Change of contact details
If there is a change to your contact details please use this form to update them.
Click here for access to the change of contact details form
Holiday/Term time leave application form
Click here for access to the application form for holiday/term time leave
Walking home alone permission form
In Year 5 and Year 6 children are allowed to walk home alone if given permission by a family member. Please complete the form below if you would like this for your child.
If you have more than one child in Year 5 or 6, please complete separate forms for each child.
Click here for access to the walking home alone permission form
Mobile phone consent form
If you need your child to bring a mobile phone to school, you must complete this form to give permission. Children younger than Years 5 & 6 are not allowed to bring mobile phones in to school.
Click here for access to the mobile phone consent form

community coffee mornings
We hold coffee mornings every Thursday from 8.50 - 9.45am, on a range of important topics for Drew families.
The programme for this term is below.
We look forward to welcoming you in!
Parent-Workshops-AUTUMN (ID 1016)
Y6 Parents - Applying to Secondary School
Mrs Sharp will hold an information session for parents of Y6 children on how to apply for a secondary school place this year.
Transition to Year 1
All Year 1 parents are invited to find out how Drew supports children moving into Year 1 and about the National Curriculum expectations.
Y6 - Preparation for SATs
Want to know how to best support your child at home as they work towards their end of year KS2 SATs? Come and find out the most useful tips and tricks from Drew staff.
EYFS Parent Group
All Nursery and Reception families are welcomed to come for a coffee and a chat. We will share information about Tapestry and help you set up your account, you can find out dates for Stay & Play sessions, meet each other and ask us any questions.
Y4 Multiplication Tables Check
Join Mrs Kalantzi to learn more about the Multiplication Test Check that all Year 4 children sit, and how best to support your child with learning their times tables at home.
